_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county.label: County
county.expects: a Maine county name WITHOUT the word 'County' (the form prints 'COUNTY'); rendered upper-case

docket_number.label: Docket Number
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

current_legal_name.label: Current Legal Name
current_legal_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

petitioner_first_name.label: Petitioner First Name
petitioner_first_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

petitioner_middle_name.label: Petitioner Middle Name
petitioner_middle_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

petitioner_last_name.label: Petitioner Last Name
petitioner_last_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

petitioner_address.label: Petitioner Address
petitioner_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

petitioner_email_address.label: Petitioner Email Address
petitioner_email_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

petitioner_date_of_birth.label: Petitioner Date Of Birth
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

petitioner_prior_names.label: Petitioner Prior Names
petitioner_prior_names.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

desired_first_name.label: Desired First Name
desired_first_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

reasons_for_change.label: Reasons For Change

request_confidential_order.label: Request Confidential Order
request_confidential_order.expects: check only if the statement is true

confidentiality_reasons.label: Confidentiality Reasons
confidentiality_reasons.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

request_no_notification.label: Request No Notification
request_no_notification.expects: check only if the statement is true

no_notification_reasons.label: No Notification Reasons

filing_date.label: Filing Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

attorney_name.label: Attorney Name
attorney_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

attorney_address.label: Attorney Address

avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
